stem.en: A model reads "Rain fell on the" and adds one more token. Put these parts in the order they happen.

text.en: Swap each token for its token id
Read each token's embedding from the table
Give every token in the list a score
Pick one token and add it to the text

explanation.en: Each part needs the one before it. A token id only finds the embedding, attention can mix numbers only once the embeddings are there, and scores come from what attention produced. Picking comes last, and then the whole loop runs again.

hints.en: Ask what each part needs before it can start.
